newsitem.title: CANADA: Bre-X shares to resume on Friday - TSE.
newsitem.headline: Bre-X shares to resume on Friday - TSE.

text.p: Shares in Canadian gold prospector Bre-X Minerals Ltd will not resume trading on the Toronto Stock Exchange on Thursday, the exchange said in a statement.
The stock stopped trading on Canada's biggest equity market at 1243 EST/1743 GMT on Thursday due to "systems problems caused by high levels of order flow in (the) company's stock," the TSE said.
The exchange said Bre-X would reopen at 0930 EST/1430 GMT on Friday. The stock finished its abbreviated session on Thursday, up 0.23 at 3.43 on 5.02 million shares.
"Systems specialists at the TSE continue to work around the clock to find solutions to this unprecedented and challenging situation," the statement said.
It was the third time this week that Bre-X's stock overwhelmed the TSE's 20-year-old trading system.
Panic selling lopped almost C$3 billion off Bre-X's stock market value last Thursday amid doubts over the size and viability of the company's Busang gold deposit in Indonesia.
Bre-X continued trading on Nasdaq and the Montreal and Alberta exchanges on Thursday.
